tool_config.name: perevod_careline_demo
tool_config.description: Puts the live call through to a person: the coordinator in office hours, the on-call coordinator for urgent shift problems at night. Use it only where the prompt allows (hiring line: office OPEN; caregiver line: office OPEN or an urgent problem on a shift). Call it WITHOUT announcing anything first — the phone system itself tells the caller they are being connected. If the result has ok true, say nothing more: a person takes over. If ok is false, say the meaning of soobshchenie and take a message. Never use it to leave a message. Never promise to stay on the line.
